mapper.select: select username, name, email from "h_member" where gym_id = #{gymId} and role = 'trainer' order by name

select r.username as "username", mem.name as "memberName", mgr.username as "managerId", mgr.name as "managerName", r.churn_rate as "churnRate" from "h_churn_result" r join "h_member" mem on r.username = mem.username join lateral ( select cd.manager_id from "h_contract_data" cd where cd.receiver_id = r.username and cd.manager_id is not null and cd.gym_id = #{gymId} order by cd.signed_at desc nulls last, cd.data_id desc limit 1 ) latest on true join "h_member" mgr on mgr.username = latest.manager_id where mem.gym_id = #{gymId} and r.churn_rate >= 0.45 and #{statKey} in (r.top1_reason, r.top2_reason, r.top3_reason)
and r.churn_date is not null and to_char(r.churn_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{period}
and r.churn_date = cast(#{period} as date)
order by r.churn_rate desc

select center_id as "centerId", center_name as "centerName", brand_name as "brandName", center_phone as "centerPhone", operating_hours as "operatingHours", onsite_repair_status as "onsiteRepair", service_center_url as "url" from "h_service_center" order by center_name
mapper.insert: insert into "h_helper" (username, title, contents, date, status) values (#{username}, '헬퍼 요청', #{contents}, CURRENT_DATE, '처리대기')
